label: End-of-episode D1 (last ~10 trials)
explanation: Fires almost only at D1 in the last ~10 trials of the 100-trial episode: 96% of activation mass is in trials 90-99, none before trial 70, and 95% of mass is at D1. It never fires at GO, and only weakly at D2 late in the episode. Rate rises steeply with ep_trial, and the strongest activations are on the final trials. This mirrors the value head: 98% of mass falls in the lowest value bin (value < 5.22), so it looks like a time-remaining / low-expected-future-reward signal. Within the late-D1 window it is stronger and more reliable when the previous reward was 1 (75% of mass on in_rew = 1) and when the previous trial reached S2 (late D1 & prev_state == 2 has precision 0.96, recall 0.47), so it is asymmetric across states. Adding the S2 clause (prev_state == 2 from trial 85, any state from trial 93) only raised dev F1 from 0.69 to 0.73, so the simpler predicate is recorded. Dev: P 0.66, R 0.73, F1 0.69, mass recall 0.91. Uses only observed variables; ep_trial is not an input but the agent can track it internally.
